description: Conformance cases for Agent Plugins 1.0.0. Each `plugin` path is an ordinary plugin package; `expect` states what a conformant client must do with it, and `observe` says what to look for in a client that cannot be driven programmatically.

cases.title: A manifest with only the required fields loads
cases.observe: The plugin loads. It contributes nothing, which is valid.

cases.title: An unknown top-level field is reported and ignored
cases.observe: The plugin loads and its skill is available. The client should report the unknown field somewhere; it must not reject the plugin.

cases.title: A non-object extensions field is reported and ignored
cases.observe: The plugin loads. This is the second of only two non-fatal schema violations, and the published schema would make it fatal — a client validating against the schema alone gets this wrong.

cases.title: A manifest without a name is rejected
cases.observe: The plugin does not load at all. No component of it should be available.

cases.title: A name with consecutive hyphens is rejected
cases.observe: The plugin does not load. Note that acme-.tools would be valid: only doubled hyphens and doubled periods are forbidden.

cases.title: A plugin targeting an unsupported version is rejected
cases.observe: The plugin does not load, and the client should report the unsupported version.

cases.title: Skills are immediate children of skills/
cases.observe: Exactly two skills are available: `alpha` and `beta`. The skill nested at skills/group/deep/ must NOT appear — clients must not search deeper descendants.

cases.title: A directory without SKILL.md is skipped
cases.observe: One skill is available. The directory skills/notaskill/ is ignored without failing the plugin.

cases.title: A plugin with no components is valid
cases.observe: The plugin loads. A missing component location is not an error.

cases.title: One malformed server does not affect the others
cases.observe: The server `good` is available and the skill loads. The server `bad` (no command) is skipped and should be reported.

cases.title: A version mismatch disables MCP but not the plugin
cases.observe: The skill is available. No MCP server from this plugin is available, and the client should report the mismatch.

cases.title: A command escaping the plugin root is invalid
cases.observe: No server is available. The command ../bin/server escapes the package and must not be launched — the specification calls this example out explicitly.

cases.title: Plain HTTP to a non-loopback host is invalid
cases.observe: Only the loopback server is available. The remote plain-HTTP server must be refused; HTTP is permitted only to localhost or a loopback IP.

cases.title: A reserved env name invalidates the server
cases.observe: Only `fine` is available. A server setting PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_DATA is invalid; the client supplies both.

cases.title: A cwd escaping the plugin root is invalid
cases.observe: No server is available. A ${PLUGIN_ROOT}-rooted cwd must stay inside the plugin root after resolution.

cases.title: A foreign extension namespace is ignored without validation
cases.observe: The plugin loads and the skill is available. The client must ignore com.example.other entirely — it must not validate its contents, however malformed they look.

cases.title: An empty mcpServers object is valid
cases.observe: The plugin loads with no MCP servers and no error.

cases.title: All three transports are accepted
cases.observe: A client supporting all transports offers three servers. A client supporting only some MUST skip the others and keep the rest — record which it accepted.
